create_VOC_dataset_instance: create a VOCDataset instance for PASCAL VOC2007 or VOC2012 object detection
load_VOC_data_list: load the VOC dataset data list from XML annotation files and image directories
parse_VOC_annotation: parse a VOC XML annotation file into bounding boxes and instance labels
filter_VOC_data: filter VOC dataset annotations by minimum bounding box size and empty ground truth
review_VOC_metainfo: review the VOCDataset METAINFO containing 20 PASCAL VOC classes and their visualization palette colors
